sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Hirata Estate is the home of the Young Lord whom Wolf is sworn to protect.
An alternate version of this memory can be accessed later.
Later, an alternate memory of Hirata Estate requires Wolf to eavesdrop on Kuro and go along with Emma's plan to search for a way to sever immortality without Kuro dying, before defeating Great Shinobi - Owl atop the Ashina Castle. Later, after eavesdropping on Emma talking to the Sculptor, Wolf can confront her and she will give the Father's Bell Charm, which unlocks this extended memory.
Sculptor's Idols:
- Dragonspring - Hirata Estate
- Estate Path
- Bamboo Thicket Slope
- Hirata Estate - Main Hall
- Hirata Audience Chamber
- Hirata Estate - Hidden Temple

sections.heading: Dragonspring, Estate Path
sections.text:

sections.heading: Hirata Estate - Main Hall
sections.text:
The Main Hall of Hirata Estate is a courtyard of grand buildings that comprise the estate proper, leading through a small pond to the Audience Chamber, peaceful room that precedes the shrine at Hirata Estate. There is a secret door that opens to the Hidden Temple, a secret place of worship.
